gloss: to go around playing; to gad about

definitions.gloss: to go around playing; to run about having fun; to gad about
definitions.explanation: To play or amuse oneself in one place after another, or all over a place. Of children it is neutral or fond; of adults it often suggests neglecting one's duties.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧たち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{公園|こうえん}→公園：00581_kouen⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{遊|あそ}び{回|まわ}って⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: The children are running around playing in the park.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夏休|なつやす}み→夏休み：02925_natsuyasumi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧{遊|あそ}び{回|まわ}って⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: During the summer holidays I was out having fun every day.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{勉強|べんきょう}→勉強：00770_benkyou⟧もしないで{遊|あそ}び{回|まわ}って⟦ばかり→〜ばかり：02006_bakari⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{親|おや}→親：01357_oya⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{心配|しんぱい}している→心配する：06066_shinpaisuru⟧。
examples.english: He just gads about without studying, so his parents are worried.

notes:
Made of ⟦{遊|あそ}ぶ→遊ぶ：00550_asobu⟧ (to play) + ⟦{回|まわ}る→回る：01150_mawaru⟧ (to go around). The 〜⟦{回|まわ}る→回る：01150_mawaru⟧ ending adds "here and there, all over": ⟦{走|はし}り{回|まわ}る→走り回る：04608_hashirimawaru⟧, ⟦{飛|と}び{回|まわ}る→飛び回る：04610_tobimawaru⟧.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: intransitive (place + で, or place + ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ for ranging over an area)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{外|そと}→外：00671_soto⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{遊|あそ}び{回|まわ}る: to play outside all over
- {遊|あそ}び{回|まわ}って⟦ばかり→〜ばかり：02006_bakari⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧: to do nothing but gad about
- ⟦{夜|よる}→夜：00487_yoru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{街|まち}→街：17306_machi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{遊|あそ}び{回|まわ}る: to go out on the town at night

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {遊|あそ}び{歩|ある}く: to go around amusing oneself; of adults, out on the town
